text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Sprinters Stakes approaches. All eyes 
are on Daiichi Ruby and K.S. Miracle to 
see which of them is truly the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle was prepared to give 
everything for victory. To repay the 
people who supported her by showing them a 
miracle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how ephemeral she was, Daiichi Ruby 
steeled her resolve. As one who stands at 
the forefront, she declared she would show 
her the "future."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby vows absolute victory. To 
guide her friend to their destined future, 
she will shine at her absolute brightest, 
believing it is her mission—
